format.quote: Application font must be Times New Roman. 3. Application font size must be 12-point. 4. Application spacing must be double-spaced with 1" margins on all sides.

eligibility.item: Private not-for-profit organizations and public or governmental agencies are eligible; for-profits are funded only if no not-for-profit is able or willing to provide quality HIV services
eligibility.quote: Private, not-for-profit organizations and public or governmental agencies are eligible to apply. A for-profit entity is eligible to apply for these funds but will only be funded if a not-for-profit organization is unable or unwilling to provide quality HIV related service(s).

eligibility.item: Not-for-profit applicants may not pass funds to a for-profit entity unless that condition is true and verified
eligibility.quote: Not-for-profit applicants are prohibited from serving as a conduit of these funds to a for-profit entity unless the above is true and verified.

eligibility.item: Applicants delivering services potentially eligible for Medicaid must be certified Colorado Medicaid providers, with proof in the application
eligibility.quote: If this application involves the delivery of services that are potentially eligible for Medicaid funding, the applicant must be certified by Colorado Medicaid as a provider of the service(s).

eligibility.item: Funds are dollars of last resort and may not pay for items or services payable by other benefits programs or insurance
eligibility.quote: These funds must be used as dollars of last resort and appropriate documentation must be included in the client file that supports this requirement.

eligibility.item: Recipients of Ryan White Part A, C, D or HOPWA must show how requested funds wrap around and do not duplicate other services
eligibility.quote: Applications from providers that receive Ryan White Part A, C, D or HOPWA must demonstrate how the funds requested will wrap around and not duplicate other services.

eligibility.item: MAI applicants must have a pre-existing working relationship and security clearance with each proposed correctional institution before submission
eligibility.quote: Applicants requesting MAI funding must have a pre-existing working relationship and have undergone security clearance with each proposed correctional institution prior to the submission of the RFA.

eligibility.item: Clinics and medical providers must enroll in CDPHE's third-party administrator, UMR
eligibility.quote: Clinics and medical provider applicants must enroll in CDPHE's third-party administrator, UMR.

eligibility.item: Services may only go to eligible clients: HIV-positive Colorado residents with household income under 500 percent of the Federal Poverty Level
eligibility.quote: Awarded applicants must document that clients are HIV-positive, are residents of Colorado, and have household income under 500 percent of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL).

eligibility.item: On-site services must be available in each region's priority cities/towns (Boulder; Fort Collins and/or Greeley; Colorado Springs and/or Pueblo; Grand Junction and/or Durango)
eligibility.quote: On-site services must be available in the following priority cities/towns: Fort Collins and/or Greeley.
There will be no reimbursement of pre-award costs.

eligibility.item: Applications must meet all criteria in the RFA
eligibility.quote: Applications must meet all criteria outlined in this RFA. Applicants that decline to meet one or more criteria, or do not demonstrate meeting all criteria, may not be considered for funding.
